name: workboard
description: AI-native dashboard for managing work projects — GitHub/Jira/Google Docs aware, with an MCP server for coding agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,mcp -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w packages/mcp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/mcp -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,mcp -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w packages/mcp"
